components.name: Primary Milestone Button
components.description: The single action that advances the current package milestone.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:46px; padding:11px 18px; border:1px solid #2457c5; border-radius:9px; background:#2457c5; color:#fff; font:700 15px Archivo,sans-serif; transition:background .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#173f99; border-color:#173f99; box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(55,48,38,.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2457c5; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Proof Control

components.description: Package progress and separate allowance truth in one compact production ticket.

components.css: .ds-ticket { display:grid; gap:14px; padding:18px 20px; border:1px solid #b9b2a5; border-radius:12px; background:#fffdf8; color:#202529; box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(55,48,38,.08); font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-ticket div { display:grid; gap:3px; } .ds-ticket small { color:#4d555b; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.07em; } .ds-ticket strong { font-size:21px; } .ds-ticket span { justify-self:end; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid #9f3028; border-radius:6px; color:#9f3028; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-ticket progress { width:100%; accent-color:#2457c5; }

components.name: Candidate Proof
components.description: A selectable portrait proof with numeric identity and explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-candidate { position:relative; width:92px; min-height:126px; padding:5px; border:1px solid #2457c5; border-radius:6px; background:#fffdf8; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #2457c5; } .ds-photo { display:block; height:106px; border-radius:3px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ece7dc,#b9b2a5); } .ds-candidate b { position:absolute; right:8px; bottom:8px; display:grid; place-items:center; width:23px; height:23px; border-radius:50%; background:#202529; color:#fff; font:800 11px Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-candidate:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2457c5; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Adjustment Field
components.description: A labeled native range control with a tabular value.
components.css: .ds-adjust { min-height:48px; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #b9b2a5; border-radius:8px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 48px; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:#fffdf8; color:#202529; font:700 13px Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-adjust input { width:100%; accent-color:#2457c5; } .ds-adjust span { color:#4d555b; text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-adjust input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2457c5; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Proof Status Stamp
components.description: A restrained textual status mark for package milestones.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid #9f3028; border-radius:6px; background:#fffdf8; color:#9f3028; font:800 11px Archivo,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; transform:rotate(-1deg); }

narrative.overview: The system behaves like a portrait studio presenting finished proofs, not an AI dashboard selling generation volume. Real photography is always the largest material. Package status reads like a clipped production ticket: factual, compact, and separate from the image itself. This world is currently implemented for /app/enhance; unrelated routes retain their incumbent systems until explicitly migrated.
keyCharacteristics: Portrait-first scale with source and candidate context kept nearby.
Warm matte paper, charcoal production ink, cobalt proof marks, and restrained status stamps.
One dominant action advances the current fulfillment milestone.
Candidate, refinement, premium add-on, and export allowances stay visibly separate.
Mobile composition preserves the same sequence and adds a safe-area-aware fulfillment action.

rules.name: The Allowance Color Rule
rules.body: Color never merges candidate, refinement, augmentation, or export meaning; labels and counts remain explicit.

rules.name: The Cobalt Rarity Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks selection, progress, focus, or the one primary action. It does not decorate passive containers.

rules.name: The Face-First Type Rule
rules.body: Typography frames the portrait and task; it never competes with the selected proof at equal scale inside the workspace.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Active Rule
rules.body: Passive controls and add-ons use borders without shadows. Elevation communicates working focus or viewport attachment.

dos: Do make the selected portrait the largest element in candidate review.
Do keep package fulfillment and allowance counts visible in plain text.
Do expose one dominant next action and keep it reachable on phones.
Do preserve native controls, focus states, 44px targets, reduced motion, and non-color status labels.
Do use real user/provider photography; controls and notation remain semantic code.
donts: Don't present candidate generation as regeneration or consume refinement/add-on allowance for initial fulfillment.
Don't show refinement, premium add-on, or download actions as the paid package's next step while candidate slots remain.
Don't turn the route into a grid of equal-weight feature cards or generic AI gradient chrome.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as the route's icon system.
Don't promote proof marks, job tickets, or route composition into unrelated surfaces without a deliberate migration.
